findings.message: Product-safe candidate overlay rows were generated.

overlay_policy.auto_review_label_policy: auto rows are review-only by default; accept_runtime labels remove the manual-acceptance blocker but still obey runtime identity blockers; reject labels remove the row
overlay_policy.manual_reject_policy: manual review rejected lemma-topic keys are not auto-promoted
overlay_policy.reading_identity_policy: runtime-effective rows require a unique corrected reading for the lemma under the current lemma-only overlay contract

source_policy.jawikipedia_dump_category: literal or title-corroborated rows retained as review candidates; runtime promotion requires manual acceptance
source_policy.jmdict_field_direct: source evidence only unless already present in the reviewed overlay
source_policy.kaikki_wiktionary_topic: strict first-sense or literal-topic rows retained as review candidates; runtime promotion requires manual acceptance
source_policy.manual_semantic_lexicon: product-owned closed-set topic collections only; facet-only collections are not promoted
source_policy.wikidata_claim_probe: exact Japanese Wikipedia pageprops QID plus structured claim path rows retained as review candidates; runtime promotion requires manual acceptance
